prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Pet Control Dashboard Redesign: Rebuilds the final desktop introduction screen into a stage layout featuring an interactive mascot preview with direct control toggles for summoning, hiding, and talking to the pet. (why: Support emails highlight that users are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding (3 emails), and finish step completion is low at 64.8%.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Generation Quality Checker Screen: Inserts a new verification step screen right after photo upload to validate photo clarity and lighting before generating the pet preview. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet looks, and adoption step drop-off is 73.1%.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Friend Selection Flow: Shifts the sign-in step to occur immediately after selecting or customizing a pet friend rather than before pick_friend. (why: Signing in before customizing a pet causes friction; moving auth closer to certificate creation keeps intent high.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Companion Path Selection Guidance Copy: Updates the choose_path screen headline and hint to clarify the difference between pre-made pet companions and custom photo generation. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s and 80.4% conversion, indicating users spend time hesitating over path differences.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Spawning Readiness Status Notice: Configures the waiting screen with desktop overlay diagnostic notifications and readiness checks. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop or app failing to open on first run, and waiting screen median time is 201s.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Spawning Completion System Notification Toggle: Enables desktop system notification when pet spawning completes while app is minimized. (why: Home waiting step mean time is 2336s (38 mins), suggesting users leave the app in the background while the pet is being generated.)

scores.note: Addresses the largest funnel drop-off (64.8%) and 3 support emails, but high effort.
Fixes custom pet generation issues, but adding a new screen creates extra friction.
Deferring auth builds intent, though sign_in step conversion is already relatively high.
Cheap copy fix addressing heavy hesitation indicated by 514s mean time.
Directly targets reported spawning failures, though target step drop-off is low.
Re-engages users leaving during long 38-minute background generation.
